user_saw: Browser-compatible QuickTime (MOV) attachments showed "Preparing playback…" for several seconds while the server re-encoded the whole clip before inline playback started.
summary: Tries a lossless stream copy (remux) to MP4 for codec-compatible MOV videos, waits up to 500 ms for it on the first playback check, shares the in-flight job across requests, falls back to a full encode, and only shows the preparing state once the server reports pending.
reasoning: The PR describes a speedup: the existing pipeline always re-encoded MOV playback renditions and returned 'preparing' immediately by design, and nothing indicates it was ever faster before. This is a performance improvement of code that was never slower than before, so not-a-defect; blame points only at a UI refactor and pre-graft code with no breaking change.
